READY.label: Ready
READY.message: You can consider booking the exam if you keep your results steady.

ALMOST_READY.label: Almost ready
ALMOST_READY.message: Focus on fixing your common mistakes and take one more mock test to be sure.

NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT.label: Needs improvement
NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT.message: You’re close, but weak domains could still pull your score down.

NOT_READY.label: Not ready
NOT_READY.message: Strengthen your fundamentals before taking another mock test.
